identity.vision: Logic over Hardware - Empowering students with zero-resource software.

biography_context.founder_story: Aditya Rai started in 2024. Using 2016-era legacy hardware, he engineered 2026-level software logic to prove that high-level coding is independent of expensive equipment.
biography_context.role_models: Self-taught through rigorous research and binary analysis.

collaboration_policy.student_access: Open-door policy for young developers to join the KYXGO ecosystem.
collaboration_policy.support: Providing structural logic to students who want to build software from scratch.
